profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Mass General Brigham
profile.summary:
Life is a journey with problem to solve and lesson to learn, but most of all, experience to enjoy! My journey in software development industry with 9+ years of experience with understanding of technology and business requirement to meet the challenges. 
7+ years of experience working as an individual and team player in Healthcare Industry.
Developed and redesigned several sites and applications for Partners Healthcare Inc, Brigham and Women’s and Mass general Hospital. 

Skill Sets:
Experience in .Net Framework 2.0/3.0/4.0/4.5, MVP Framework
Ektron CMS400 v7.6/8.0/8.5, Open text Content Management System 7.5/16.0
Extensive experience in web applications using Visual Studio 2003/2005, 2008, 2010/2012, 2013/2015,2017 languages C#.NET and VB.NET. 
Extensive knowledge in design and development of user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, XML, XSLT.
Experience of JavaScript, jQuery and Perl scripting.
Experience of Google Geolocation API, Google Maps, fusion charts.
Experience in Sql Server and MS Access.
Experience of Azure Platform with Metalogix content matrix. 
Performed various roles like requirements analyst, designer, developer, tester, and reviewer for web applications.
Excellent verbal and interpersonal skills; good analytical and debugging skills; systematic approach to system architecture design and programming tasks.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Analyzing, designing and developing applications and sites using .net technology with a focus on c# and OpenText content management platform for the Partners Healthcare Corporate Umbrella. 

During project development life cycle provide guild lines and work closely with Business Analyst and Project managers alone with keeping each projects vision on track. 

Aligning various size of application with functional specification document and building UI components and reusable class libraries.  

Design and Maintain templates, Components, layouts using OpenText Content Management System 7.5/16.

Responsible for deployment of the sites and applications in production.

24X7 Web Development and SharePoint On Call Support.

Support and Manage SharePoint 2010, SharePoint Office 365 sites and E-Room. 

Support and Manage SharePoint 2010, SharePoint Office 365 sites, with the extensive experience of Center Admin and Metalogix tool for SharePoint migration with Azure platform.

Support and Manage E-Room with direct interaction to the end user and generating various e-room reports using sql.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop websites and applications based on .Net Framework using Ektron’s CMS400.NET
•	Analyze the functional requirements, build implementation guide based on functional specifications. 
•	Develop reusable widgets with Ektron’s Page builder technology, used JavaScript for client side validations and built UI components using JQuery.
•	Through organizational cut across boundaries, provide fixes to the issues in system and acceptance testing of the project deliverables.
•	Based on customer’s requirements enhanced existing website using Ektron’s CMS400.NET features.
•	Prepare site documentation and user guide for websites that provide precise information of code and functionality used across the site.
•	Client Interaction: To get in touch with the clients to gather/understand their requirements and follow up with demonstration/presentations of ongoing projects.
•	Multitasking: Implement ongoing projects and support the projects under the acceptance testing to provide solutions to the issues.
•	Take an initiative to perform load testing for the sites and enhance them until the expected results are achieved.
•	Perform testing on individual user controls and widgets.
•	Provide prioritization to the project tasks to improve product efficiency and on time delivery.

positions.title: NET Programmer
positions.description:
•	Work as individual contributor to develop and enhance websites and web application using .net framework. 		
•	Develop website for hospital jobs, which can used by job seekers to create profile and search for hospital jobs and employers can post jobs and search for the candidates match to their job postings, URL for more. www.hospitaldreamjobs.com
•	Enhance and fix issues in web applications.
•	Perform SQL queries, create and alter tables and views using Postgre-SQL.

positions.title: Business System Analyst
positions.description:
•	Perform lead BA/developer role in projects through all phases of system development.
•	Communicate and coordinate with customers for ongoing projects.
•	Analyze and apply Glovia ERP Patch and re-apply customization to functions while adhering to customization standards and tracking process.
•	Assist with solving Glovia Solution Center calls. Successfully analyze and provide solution to calls.
•	Customize functions of Glovia ERP using PRO-IVsl.
•	Work with Production Control Office and Project Management Office.
•	Create and modify reports according to customer’s request.
•	Analyze and re-build SQL queries.
•	Received professional Project Management training.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed and Enhanced System for the operators to enter test data, provide different charts for the part of products and process using Asp.net 3.5, C# and Sql Server.
•	Analyze and fixing system bugs.
•	Perform quality test prior to release

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Application (MCA); Computer Science and Technology

skills.name: C#, ASP.NET (2.0/3.0/3.5), Ektron CMS400.NET, C, C++, XML, XSLT, CSS, HTML
JavaScript (JQuery), VB 6.0, VBScript, Pro-IVsl, SQL, ERP.
Certification:		.net certification, Ektron Administrator, Ektron Developer
Testing Tools:		HP load Runner, QTP.
